description: A terminal tag test reads the tags by which the terminal matched, so T⊇T holds of the synthetic T, and c is a second reading. Compare reparse-reference-tag-test (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T]
%rule b A [T] [U]
%rule c A T⊇T
